ABSTRACT 
This invention relates to fabric and home care products 
comprising one or more cold water proteases and processes 
for making and using such products . Such compositions 
provide improved cleaning and freshness . Such cold water 
proteases may be derived from parent enzymes , including 
BPN 
' subtilisin and subtilisin derived from Bacillus lentus , 
by substitution , insertion and / or deletion of one or more of 
the parent enzymes ' amino acids .

proteases may be derived from parent enzymes , including 
BPN 
' subtilisin and subtilisin derived from Bacillus lentus ,
